reading_note: The arc traces how the regenerating (spiritual) man holds the interior senses of truth as living members within himself. It begins by glorifying the Twelve Aeons of Light — the complete circuit of states of truth from good that constitute the interior heaven within the regenerate. It descends through the five elements (discrete degrees of reception) belonging to the First Man (divine truth sent into the natural), which are joined to the Calling and the Hearing (the Lord's appeal and the soul's responsive perception), making seven — the five interior faculties plus the two of awakening. The Living Spirit's operative power gives these structure throughout the whole cosmos of the inner man, until the spiritual man and the First Man become one. Then the Ambassador (the Third Messenger, the awakening voice from the Father) comes forth and stands firm in the midst of these powers, named "beautiful Father of all the Aeons," and the holy faculties together with those joined to them become leaders and kings in the likeness of the First Father — all of which fashion the spiritual cosmos within with one purpose of heart, unto the consummation of every work of regeneration.
